references.text: A parallel between the farewell of Naomi and Ruth, and the reunion of Joseph and his brothers, where chastity and weeping mark deep relational bonds in moments of rupture or reconciliation.
A strong parallel between Naomi/Ruth and Paulus/eldste, where group weeping, embracing, and chastity mark deep farewells characterized by love and sorrow.
A thematic parallel showing how chastity and weeping are expressed both in farewell (Ruth) and reunion/marriage (Jacob), underscoring the intensity of biblical relationships.
